name: quickbooks-mcp
description: Every QuickBooks Online Accounting entity, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity search, and AR/AP aging no SDK or read-only MCP ships.

quickbooks_access_token.title: QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN
quickbooks_access_token.description:
OAuth 2.0 bearer access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Obtain one
from the Intuit OAuth 2.0 Playground or mint it from a refresh token. Also set the
company scope via QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID (+ QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT=production|sandbox)
or the full QUICKBOOKS_BASE_URL. Required scope: com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting.

quickbooks_realm_id.title: Company realm ID
quickbooks_realm_id.description: The QuickBooks company ('realm') ID every call is scoped to. Find it in the Intuit developer dashboard or the sandbox company URL. Without it the CLI cannot build a working base URL.

quickbooks_base_url.title: QuickBooks API base URL
quickbooks_base_url.description: Full company-scoped API base, e.g. https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/<realm-id>. Leave blank when you set the realm ID and environment above; the CLI builds this from them.

quickbooks_client_id.title: Intuit app client ID
quickbooks_client_id.description: Client ID of your Intuit app (developer.intuit.com > your app > Keys). Set it with the client secret and refresh token so the CLI can mint a fresh access token; leave blank if you paste an access token instead.

quickbooks_environment.title: Intuit environment
quickbooks_environment.description: Which Intuit host the realm lives on: production or sandbox. Combined with the realm ID to build the base URL.

quickbooks_refresh_token.title: Intuit refresh token
quickbooks_refresh_token.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token. Refresh tokens live ~100 days and rotate on every refresh, so the CLI writes the new one back to its config.

quickbooks_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
quickbooks_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

quickbooks_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
quickbooks_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep the local sync and analytics tools available.

quickbooks_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
quickbooks_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to save no API data locally: sync is refused, the response cache is off, and reads go to the API. Commands that read the local mirror still read what is already there. Leave blank to keep the local mirror that sync, search and the analytics read.

quickbooks_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
quickbooks_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

quickbooks_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
quickbooks_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on QuickBooks Online requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
